# Build unmodified vendored Xiph sources without running their legacy top-level
# CMake (which mutates global install/testing options and requires old policies).
set(task_ogg "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../libogg")
set(task_vorbis "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../libvorbis")
add_library(DependencyOgg STATIC "${task_ogg}/src/bitwise.c" "${task_ogg}/src/framing.c")
target_include_directories(DependencyOgg PUBLIC "${task_ogg}/include")
if(NOT WIN32)
    set(SIZE16 int16_t)
    set(USIZE16 uint16_t)
    set(SIZE32 int32_t)
    set(USIZE32 uint32_t)
    set(SIZE64 int64_t)
    set(USIZE64 uint64_t)
    set(INCLUDE_INTTYPES_H 1)
    set(INCLUDE_STDINT_H 1)
    set(INCLUDE_SYS_TYPES_H 1)
    configure_file("${task_ogg}/include/ogg/config_types.h.in" "include/ogg/config_types.h" @ONLY)
    target_include_directories(DependencyOgg PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include")
endif()
set(task_vorbis_sources mdct smallft block envelope window lsp lpc analysis synthesis psy info
    floor1 floor0 res0 mapping0 registry codebook sharedbook lookup bitrate vorbisfile)
list(TRANSFORM task_vorbis_sources PREPEND "${task_vorbis}/lib/")
list(TRANSFORM task_vorbis_sources APPEND ".c")
add_library(DependencyVorbis STATIC ${task_vorbis_sources})
add_library(DependencyDrWav INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(DependencyDrWav INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../dr_wav")
target_include_directories(DependencyVorbis PUBLIC "${task_vorbis}/include" PRIVATE "${task_vorbis}/lib")
target_link_libraries(DependencyVorbis PUBLIC DependencyOgg)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_definitions(DependencyOgg PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
    target_compile_definitions(DependencyVorbis PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS _CRT_NONSTDC_NO_DEPRECATE)
elseif(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(DependencyVorbis PRIVATE m)
endif()
